desc: This update adds new patterns for patient name and age, allergies and intolerances, observations, orders and procedures including imaging, as well as claims and explanations of benefits. In addition, the update includes derived model information libraries for US Core, QI Core, and CarinBB to enable those IGs to be referenced in quality improvement artifacts.
